'''Brave Greenhorn''' is an injured [[tauren]] brave located just south of [[Bloodhoof Village]] in [[Mulgore]]. He was injured after fighting the [[Venture Co.]] that had overrun the [[Winterhoof Water Well]].

==Objective of==
* He must be healed and fortified for {{questlong|Horde|5|Garments of the Three Siblings|race=tauren|class=priest}}.
